item.description:
Open
The draft conscription framework being discussed between Eisenkot’s representatives and the ultra-Orthodox parties includes the abolition of enlistment quotas and a provision allowing anyone studying Torah in a kollel to continue their studies without facing sanctions.

According to the report by Yishai Cohen and myself, the framework would also include a public call by leading rabbis for those who are not studying Torah to enlist in the military. Oversight measures would be tightened to ensure that Torah studies are genuine rather than fictitious, including the introduction of biometric identification systems in yeshivas. However, previous attempts to enforce such oversight have all failed.

The framework also includes expanding military service tracks specifically designed for the ultra-Orthodox community.

The major question is whether the High Court of Justice would approve such a sweeping exemption law without enlistment quotas or targets, contrary to its previous rulings.

A key figure in the negotiations is Raz Nizri, who, during his time as a legal official, endorsed a similar framework. This is one of the reasons Eisenkot chose him as his representative in the negotiations.

The Yashar Party issued the following statement:

“In light of developments in the negotiations currently taking place through several channels, we have been inundated in recent hours with inquiries and questions, many of which are based on incorrect or incomplete information.

“Given the extreme sensitivity of the situation and the profound sense of responsibility with which we are working to establish a government, we will refrain from commenting on the various reports and speculations.

“Responsibility for the accuracy of published information rests solely with those who publish it.”

Following the article I published here ☝️on Sunday evening, I want to emphasize just how problematic the use of the term "Jewish terror" is from the Israeli interest perspective.

The use of the term "Jewish terror," in an attempt to smear the community of Judea and Samaria residents who physically block Palestinian terror, is, in my eyes, equivalent to the calls for refusal before 7.10. Calls about which, two years ago, former IDF spokesperson Daniel Hagari said that the way Hamas perceived them was among the reasons for the massacre.

I think many are missing the main point here.

The screamers of "Jewish terror" aim to harm a particular segment of the Israeli population for their own reasons, but the enemy outside and Israel-haters hear something entirely different. Just like in the months leading up to the 7.10 massacre.

The screamers of "Jewish terror" do not distance sanctions from Israel; they bring them closer at a rapid pace and give them momentum.

If the screamers of "Jewish terror" think that they themselves will not be harmed by these sanctions, they are mistaken. Exactly as happened on 7.10.
The use of the term "Jewish terror" directs the beam of hatred toward all Jews—and the screamers are among them.
And as it is said:

"And since he removed himself from the community, he denied the essence." (And from here it follows that it is appropriate to blunt his teeth... which are too sharp).

The screamers of "Jewish terror" strengthen those who call for "the liberation of Palestine from the river to the sea." And after all, they too live there, between the sea and the river. This applies to them as well.

To remove any doubt, I will emphasize: Nationalist crime offenders must be punished to the full extent of the law. Their actions cause international damage to Israel's image.

However, the screamers of "Jewish terror" and the promoters of this campaign are causing damage many times greater. Their campaign, unfortunately, is succeeding more than expected.
They must remember: "He who digs a pit will fall into it."

​כתבת שטח של רשת "אל-מסירה" החות'ית מתעדת כמויות עצומות של פריטי וארגזי אמל"ח שנפלו לידי החות'ים לאחר שהשתלטו על מחנות צבאיים באזור העיר האסטרטגית אל-מוח'א שבחוף המערבי של תימן.

​בתיעוד כתב הרשת מסייר בתוך עשרות מכולות ומחסנים - בהם מחנה של "חטיבות הענקים הדרומיות" הסלפים והפרו-אמירתים, המכילים אלפי ארגזי תחמושת, רקטות וטילים, פגזי ארטילריה ומרגמות 120 מ"מ, תותחי וטילי נ"מ, כטב"מים ורחפנים, וכן משאיות ומכליות דלק.

​בכתבה מוצגות גם משאיות אמל"ח עם לוחיות רישוי סעודיות כשהן עמוסות בציוד צבאי, לצד מסמכים של נהגים זרים ונהגים תושבי סעודיה, ובהם נהג בעל אזרחות פקיסטנית, שלטענת החות'ים הובילו את משלוחי הנשק.

​לפי הרשת החות'ית מדובר בשלל הגדול ביותר שנתפס מתחילת מלחמת האזרחים בתימן - הכולל שלל אמצעים שיועדו למתקפה לכיבוש צנעא, כאשר חלק מהאמל"ח כבר מוסב לשימוש נגד כוחות הקואליציה הפרו-סעודית.

בתגובה החות'ים מאיימים לתקוף 4 נמלים לאורך הים האדום - שהם מאיימים הם בד"כ מקיימים.

1. נמל ג'דה - הנמל הימי המרכזי והגדול ביותר של סעודיה בים האדום.

​2. נמל ג'יזאן - הנמל הדרומי של סעודיה, הסמוך לגבול עם תימן.

​3. נמל התעשייה המלך פהד - ממוקם בעיר התעשייה ינבוע; זהו הנמל הגדול ביותר בעולם לטעינת נפט גולמי, מוצרים מזוקקים ופטרוכימיקלים בים האדום.

​4. נמל ינבוע - הנמל המסחרי של ינבוע (צפונית לג'דה), המהווה מוקד אסטרטגי לייצוא אנרגיה וסחורות במערב סעודיה.

לחות'ים אין הרבה מה להפסיד ותקיפות בנמל חודידה מכאיבות הרבה פחות מאשר פגיעה בגורד שחקים בריאד. לסעודיה יש הרבה יותר מה להפסיד.
